subject: Mediterranean eating pattern linked to two mitochondrial microproteins
script: From Agewell Brief: Mediterranean eating pattern linked to two mitochondrial microproteins. A small pilot study finds that older adults who closely follow a Mediterranean eating pattern have higher blood levels of two mitochondrial microproteins tied to cellular health. Higher adherence to Mediterranean diet linked to more humanin and SHMOOSE. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
